identity_note: 009 is proposed to follow CAL-008; verify and register the identifier before sealing. No independent validation is claimed.
question: Does the fixed M3 2.3.0 candidate generalise to public surfaces from entities absent from previous M3 human-labelled development?
claim_scope: Surface-level ecological validation, conditional on bounded discovery; not prevalence, completeness of item discovery, or validation of M5/M6/AI.
entity_selection_basis: Existing CORPORA/config at aaf11778f26bbbaa43aa1aa9e13e4d7f06455864; no new live inspection or predictions used. Novelty is relative to M3 labelled sets, not all MAR collection history. Shared technologies may remain.

exclusion_policy.supplemental_rule: Before seal, inventory all later development fixtures/URLs and documented aliases. Never treat 117 as an upper limit.
exclusion_policy.url_identity: Lowercase scheme/host, remove default port and fragment; retain path case, query values and ordering. Check exact URL and conservative key for requested and redirected URLs. Known aliases and same-item language variants remain excluded when identifiable without labels.
exclusion_policy.new_sample_duplicates: First occurrence of conservative URL key across all entities wins; log every duplicate and exclusion before applying caps.

sampling.ordering: Frozen discovery traversal order; first six unique non-excluded URL records per entity, including error/restriction records. Select before classification; no class balancing, media-based enrichment or manual URL insertion.
sampling.insufficient_sample: Stop before review if total <24 or entities <5. Preserve insufficient-sample run; no replacement entities, extra crawl, or cherry-picked rerun.
sampling.retry_policy: No result-driven reruns. A technical interruption may resume only persisted state with the same sealed code/config; refetch or loss of state invalidates the run. Preserve failures.

labels.unit: Main observed page/snapshot, not a linked media file, parent or institution. An embed alone does not make an editorial/index page an item.
labels.review: One primary human reviewer, ID, timestamp, evidence reference and rationale on every unit. No inter-rater reliability claim. Clarifications only before freeze and without model disclosure; preserve amendments.
labels.temporal_rule: Judge frozen observation evidence. Later live checks are separately dated context and cannot silently replace the source snapshot or historical access label.

blinding.evidence_rule: Provide raw captured evidence, not classifier explanations or derived access labels. A raw HTTP response is evidence, not a supplied human label.
blinding.prediction_storage: Seal predictions before review in restricted durable storage accessible to the custodian, not reviewer. Publish only digest/provenance and blinded queue. Public GitHub predictions or publicly accessible workflow artifacts are not an adequate blind.
blinding.disclosure: Only after all human rows and a separate review freeze manifest are persisted.

metrics.fine: All selected units; confusion matrix with rows human, columns model in listed nine-class order; exact accuracy, per-class precision/recall/F1, support-weighted F1, macro F1 for all classes and human-supported classes.
metrics.zero_division: Per-class precision/recall/F1 with zero denominator =0 for multiclass summaries; explicitly mark absent support. No selective class removal from weighted F1.
metrics.binary: Exclude only human unknown/null. Model abstention/unknown is non-item, so a missed human item is FN. TP/TN/FP/FN, precision TP/(TP+FP), recall TP/(TP+FN), specificity TN/(TN+FP), F1 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), accuracy (TP+TN)/N.
metrics.binary_zero_denominator: Report null, never perfect score. Any required gate metric undefined yields INCONCLUSIVE unless another evaluable gate already fails.
metrics.access: Exact agreement over every selected unit; unknown is a category, not an excluded row. Report confusion matrix separately.
metrics.integrity: Missing/duplicate/extra IDs, missing predictions or invalid human-label/item mapping invalidate evaluation; never shrink denominator to matching rows.
metrics.per_entity: Report support, TP/TN/FP/FN and exact agreement for every entity. Alias/language siblings clustered in descriptive diagnostics; no independence or population confidence claim.

gates.threshold_policy: Reuse existing VAL-007 operational thresholds; no adoption of extra F1 or stricter access suggestions from conversation.

item_level.entity_rule: Every entity with >=2 human item units must have TP>=1.

gates.comparison: Use full precision, >= boundary; rounded displays do not decide gates.
gates.decision: Report all three gates separately. Integrity failure = INVALID. Any evaluable criterion failure = FAIL. Otherwise missing sample sufficiency/undefined required metric = INCONCLUSIVE. PASS requires all criteria evaluable and met. Only all-gate PASS supports a later explicit M4 advancement decision; no automatic deployment.

readiness_requirements: Verify/register VAL-007, CAL-008 and proposed VAL-009 in the experiment registry without modifying historical records.
Freeze candidate wrapper AND imported 2.2.0 base, discovery, configuration, sampling/queue builder, evaluator, exclusions, codebook and dependency versions with SHA-256 and exact commit.
Implement explicit candidate dispatch and matching version metadata: existing queue builder currently imports the 2.2.0 classifier.
Remove derived collector_access_state from the blinded queue and verify no prediction leak in files/logs/artifacts shared with reviewer.
Implement and test the specified URL exclusion/deduplication and metric rules with synthetic/development data only.
Verify source identities/active status and supplemental development exposure before sealing, without selecting on new model outcomes.
Record durable private prediction storage, custodian and reviewer roles; do not proceed if blinding cannot be enforced.
freeze_sequence: Complete readiness checks using known data only
Seal implementation, protocol and exclusion inventory before sampling
Execute one bounded discovery run and persist raw snapshots
Select units without predictions; enforce sufficiency and exclusions
Generate and seal predictions; release only blinded queue/evidence
Complete human review then persist separate human freeze
Open predictions, evaluate once, record every gate and limitation
prohibited: No use of 117 known units as new independent evidence
No tuning, entity replacement, relabelling, threshold changes or new sampling after seal
No M4 promotion from development replay
